title: augment-vir grep search patterns permit shell command injection
summary: The grep() helper places caller-controlled search patterns in a Bash command. Command substitution inside a pattern runs as the Node.js process user.

severity.rationale: Search tooling can turn untrusted arguments into process-level execution. Agent tool arguments commonly cross this trust boundary.

exposure: A downstream application must pass untrusted input to the pattern or patterns field of grep(). Installing the package alone does not establish reachability.

params.instructions: Check @augment-vir/node version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
